text:
mina: quick thread following the RFC: we need a clear autonomy boundary so runtimes can act fast without fighting the control plane. proposing the term "graceful autonomy".
alex: +1. define it: runtime may take temporary protective actions (<90s) when signals are CRITICAL and must publish an immutable event. control plane adjudicates sustained state.
frank: we should avoid per-request chatty signals. runtime emits aggregated event windows (window_ms, samples, p95, err_rate) and a short signal_tag. control plane can request more detail if needed.
mina: important UX: events must include decision_id and a human-friendly summary for oncall. also include actionability= {INFO,ACTIONABLE,CRITICAL}.
ops-bot: deploybot: canary start 2026-08-03T08:12Z svc=router rev=canary-az9.
alex: cooldown model: local debounce 30-90s; if runtime took action it gets a preempt lease attempt with desired_ttl. control plane can grant longer global lease.
sara: question: should runtime keep ephemeral state to avoid repeated requests? tradeoff: easier coordination vs upgrade complexity. I'm leaning lightweight state (last decision id + expiry).
frank: agree lightweight ledger per node is ok if it's simple. keep snapshot format tiny. avoid schema churn.
mina: API sketch: SetFallback(decision_id, cohort, level, expiry_ms, actor) over mTLS. runtime exposes GetLease(decision_id) for reconciliation.
alex: telemetry: flat json-lines: cohort, decision_id, source, level, reason_code, actionability, p95_ms, samples, ttl_ms, note. short keys.
sara: reason_code enum idea: LAT_P99, KVS_LAG, OOM, MODEL_CONF_DROP, THROTTLE. keep changes via PR only.
mina: simulation: we need a replay harness that can inject cross-AZ noise to validate quorum logic. frank, can you own a prototype?
frank: yes. will aim for minimal harness that replays 500k requests with injects and outputs flip counts.
mina: action items: (1) alex + mina: proto + telemetry schema PR this week (2) frank: sim prototype next week (3) sara: one-pager on runtime ledger tradeoffs.
ops-bot: alert: elevated fallback-rate detected for canary-az9 at 08:15Z.
mina: thanks everyone, we'll reconvene after prototypes.
